WorkBuddy official credits, OpenDesign workspace queries, Xiaomi MiMo Token Plan via console cookie, local credits metering for the SCNet Token Plan and Volcano Ark Coding Plan via AK/SK signature), plan/API dual-track billing with per-1% & full-window Token Plan usage estimates, custom provider balance lookup (configurable HTTP endpoint) and balance progress bar, plus peak/off-peak pricing display with pre-switch popup & system-notification alerts (position / lead time / type configurable), in a bilingual (Chinese/English) UI.

plugins.name: dsh-usd-3d-preview
plugins.title: dsh-usd-3d-preview
plugins.description: In-browser OpenUSD 3D preview for the DeepSeek Harness sidebar: registers a document preview for .usd/.usda/.usdc/.usdz, composes the stage with a WebAssembly OpenUSD engine (composition arcs included), renders it with three.js in a studio-lit viewport, and makes authored UsdPhysics joints and colliders interactive. Three read-back modes explain the stage — complete LIVRPS composition arcs per prim, a layer-stack composition panel, and a USDA text mode (authored text, or a labelled reconstruction of a binary crate) — plus a prim-path inspector and a prim details panel. Previews a human+agent modeling-session archive by its `session.json`: the newest `snapshots/<rev>.usda` renders through that same viewport, with a panel stating the session id, model revision and the newest commit record's object summary. Optional read-only S3-compatible asset-library support: `s3://` and http(s) stages open by address (referenced layers included), a sidebar object-storage browser, and a local-checkout updater (terminal command and a Settings/Plugins update panel). No converter process, no upload, no native toolchain
